title: Summitcraft
description: Adds various things from the game SUMMITMYTH, including biomes, items, materials, and other things.
body:
# 🏔 About Summitcraft 🏔
Summitcraft is a mod centered around the game SUMMITMYTH, with the goal of the mod being to accurately recreate content from the real game.
This mod adds new biomes to explore, new materials to build with, and new music, straight from the real SUMMITMYTH.

![Summitcraft logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ec2e2b0fdfbce79a9a8a1f27194ae003072258d.png)

## 🏔 Additions 🏔
Summitcraft adds:
- A new Hotspring biome - A recreation of the real hotspring from SUMMITMYTH - a tropical version of Undertale's Snowdin.
- A new material - Azurite, which is used for the craft of many different new decorative blocks, like the Azurite Flower Pot, or Refined Azurite Bricks.
- Music discs, which contain the game's OST (Used with the permission of the composers)
- Minor features, like a Lime fruit, which grows on Hotspring trees, or a rat mob.
